source.publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

lines.en: 1. The company is planning to recruit more staff, isn't it?
lines.zh: 1. 公司打算招募更多員工，對吧？

lines.en: (A) No, they're not included.
(B) Yes, two and a half will be enough.
(C) Absolutely, that's our top priority.
lines.zh: (C) 當然，那是我們的首要任務。

lines.en: 2. How long will we have to wait for a table?
lines.zh: 2. 我們要等多久才有位子？

lines.en: (A) Approximately fourteen meters.
(B) Would you prefer to sit indoors or outdoors?
(C) I'm sorry, it's overweight.
3. I'm trying a vegetarian diet for the next month.
lines.zh: 3. 我接下來一個月要嘗試吃素。

lines.en: (A) The next appointment.
(B) I have some recipes that you can test out.
lines.zh: (B) 我有一些食譜可以讓你試試。

lines.en: (C) Of course, I'll buy it.
4. Where do you think the new printer should be installed?
lines.zh: 4. 你覺得新的印表機應該裝在哪裡？

lines.en: (A) The purchase was not authorized by the manager.
lines.zh: (A) 這筆採購沒有經過經理核准。

lines.en: (B) Fifteen color copies, please.
(C) I already downloaded the program.
lines.zh: (C) 我已經下載那個程式了。

lines.en: 5. When are you meeting the client from Munich?
lines.zh: 5. 你什麼時候要和慕尼黑的客戶見面？

lines.en: (A) I am familiar with that place.
(B) Have you seen the latest brochures?
lines.zh: (B) 你看過最新的簡介了嗎？

lines.en: (C) At 9 A.M. on Tuesday.
6. Why is everyone leaving early today?
lines.zh: 6. 為什麼大家今天都提早離開？

lines.en: (A) To prepare for the conference this afternoon.
lines.zh: (A) 為了準備今天下午的會議。

lines.en: (B) Take the next street on your left.
(C) A little bit later.
7. What topics do we need to address during the next staff meeting?
lines.zh: 7. 下次員工會議我們需要討論哪些議題？

lines.en: (A) Yes, today's meeting was quite productive.
lines.zh: (A) 是的，今天的會議很有成效。

lines.en: (B) Either in the auditorium or the lobby.
(C) I think we should discuss the new payroll procedures.
lines.zh: (C) 我想我們應該討論新的薪資作業流程。

lines.en: 8. Where can I catch a bus to the airport?
lines.zh: 8. 我可以在哪裡搭到往機場的公車？

lines.en: (A) You'll have to take a taxi.
(B) The nine o'clock flight.
(C) We need two tickets, please.
9. Would you be interested in taking a tour of our office space?
lines.zh: 9. 你有興趣參觀我們的辦公空間嗎？

lines.en: (A) The memo is three pages.
(B) It's a follow-up interview.
(C) Certainly, I'd like to see it.
10. Who will be presenting at the technology conference?
lines.zh: 10. 誰會在科技研討會上發表？

lines.en: (A) Is that science fiction popular?
lines.zh: (A) 那部科幻作品受歡迎嗎？

lines.en: (B) They're going to host a conference call.
lines.zh: (B) 他們要主持一場電話會議。

lines.en: (C) I haven't checked the program brochure yet.
11. When did you begin your new job?
lines.zh: 11. 你什麼時候開始新工作的？

lines.en: (A) At nine o'clock every morning.
(B) Just two weeks ago.
(C) Administrative assistant there.
12. Has the mail arrived yet?
(A) I can't get email. My computer is broken.
lines.zh: (A) 我收不到電子郵件，我的電腦壞了。

lines.en: (B) No, it usually doesn't arrive until noon.
(C) Yes, he's in his office.
13. Don't you want to take your briefcase with you?
(A) Because we're starting a new case.
lines.zh: (A) 因為我們要開始一個新案子。

lines.en: (B) No, she's in a hurry.
(C) No, it's too heavy.
14. What is the fine for overdue books?
(A) You can borrow videos, too.
(B) Sorry, it's our store policy.
(C) It's ten cents a day.
15. I need to mail this invoice to the head office, right?
lines.zh: 15. 我得把這張發票寄到總公司，對吧？

lines.en: (A) No, I can't hear your voice.
(B) Turn it in to your supervisor first.
(C) I think we should take a right here.
lines.zh: (C) 我想我們應該在這裡右轉。

lines.en: 16. Is that a new lens on your camera?
lines.zh: 16. 你相機上那是新鏡頭嗎？

lines.en: (A) I got it last year.
(B) I want to buy contact lenses.
(C) My camera has a zoom lens.
17. How long is the warranty on your tablet computer?
lines.zh: 17. 你的平板電腦保固多久？

lines.en: (A) About three feet long.
(B) It's for two years.
(C) Since last April.
18. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance, Mr. Finch.
lines.zh: 18. 很高興認識您，Finch 先生。

lines.en: (A) So am I.
(B) Good to hear.
(C) Likewise, Mrs. Clark.
lines.zh: (C) 我也很高興認識您，Clark 女士。

lines.en: 19. What do you think I should wear to the ceremony?
lines.zh: 19. 你覺得我該穿什麼去參加典禮？

lines.en: (A) An awards ceremony.
(B) A suit and tie.
(C) Just normal wear and tear.
20. Would you like a ride to the bus terminal?
lines.zh: 20. 要不要載你去公車總站？

lines.en: (A) Right across from Terminal 3.
(B) Thanks, I really appreciate it.
(C) No problem, I'll do it right away.
